references.text: A previous count of the Levites showing the total number of Levite men from one month old and upward, which was 22,000.
The number of the Kohathites who were counted by their clans was 2,750, part of the total in verse 48.
The number of the Gershonites who were counted was 2,630, part of the total in verse 48.
The number of the Merarites who were counted was 3,200, part of the total in verse 48.
The introduction to the combined count of all Levites between 30 and 50 years old who were to serve at the tabernacle.
Regulations concerning the age for Levitical service, confirming that they were to serve from age 25 until 50.
